messages:
maria: Heads-up team 3: final check for the May 6 webinar social schedule. Need: final X copy + two LinkedIn post lengths, carousel images, and routing tags for inbound. Can someone own copy + UTMs?
aj: Ill own copy + UTMs. Will do short X variants (1 playful, 1 technical) and long LinkedIn drafts.

maria: Awesome. Sam/Leo can you confirm carousel order and sizes? Need 3 slides for LinkedIn: problem, approach, demo CTA. Also hero images in 16:9 and 1:1 for X cards.
sam: Confirmed. Ill export carousel in order and add both hero sizes to Drive. Link soon.

leo: Adding a darker hero alt for X teaser too (hero_1x1_dark.png). Uploading now.

maria: For routing: plan is X replies -> SDR triage (lia), LinkedIn comments with interest keywords -> nurture flow (email). Lia, you good to pick up X replies within 2 hours of post?

lia: Yep, Ill monitor the thread and flag SQLs. Please add &hub_tag=x_reply to the shortlink so we can filter.

aj: Will add UTM and hub tag. Proposed example: ?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=web_may6&utm_content=variantA&hub_tag=x_reply

maria: Copy timing proposal (react with :white_check_mark: to confirm):
```
X (short):
 - Wed 09:00 PT: Teaser (one-line + hero 1:1) A/B image test
 - Wed 12:00 PT: Registration CTA (variant tag A/B) + pin FAQ comment
LinkedIn (long + carousel):
 - Wed 10:00 PT: Carousel post (3 cards) + long copy
 - Thu 11:00 PT: Speaker highlight + pull quote
```

aj: Drop copy variants here:
Variant A (playful): "We make huge models feel small. Watch our live demo May 6  save your seat -> short.ly/A"
Variant B (technical): "Production LLM inference: latency, cost, and reliability at scale. Live demo May 6  register -> short.ly/B"

maria: Good mix. For LinkedIn, use Variant B as lead and expand with 3 bullets: 1) runtime optimizations, 2) routing/fallback, 3) cost controls.
sam: Uploaded drive: https://drive.google.com/fake/webinar_may6 (carousel + hero_16x9.png + hero_1x1.png + hero_1x1_dark.png).

maria: Scheduler ops: can the bot create drafts for review once AJ confirms final copy?
scheduler-bot: Drafts created in scheduler: X @ 2026-05-06 09:00 PT (teaser, image A), X @ 2026-05-06 12:00 PT (reg CTA), LinkedIn @ 2026-05-06 10:00 PT (carousel). Status: pending approval.

maria: Engagement follow-ups: lia will triage X replies (2h SLA). For LinkedIn comments with product-intent keywords (demo, pricing, POC), tag high and add to nurture. AJ, include &hub_tag=li_comment when building links.
aj: Will add hub_tag=li_comment for LinkedIn shortlinks. Also adding variant param so we can A/B measure creative vs copy.

sam: One more test idea: CTA text A = "Save your spot" vs B = "See the demo live". We'll A/B on the registration tweet only.

maria: Yes, A/B both creative (dark vs light hero) and CTA text. Metrics to track first 72h: impressions, CTR, registration rate, replies -> SDR leads. Reporting: quick morning summary after launch + 72h wrap.

leo: Minor creative ask: can we get a slide with a short benchmark stat (latency 3-10x improvement)? need approval to pull numbers from eng.
maria: Liaisoned with eng-ml earlier; use phrasing "latency improvements in common workloads" without exact number unless eng signs off. Please flag if you need the exact stat.

aj: Final step for me: will generate shortlinks with UTM+hub_tag and put them in the copy doc. Expect by EOD.
maria: Great. Blockers?

leo: none.

lia: none. monitoring set.

sam: scheduler team  please lock drafts after AJ uploads final copy.
scheduler-bot: Locked drafts updated after final copy approval. Will publish at scheduled times once approved.

maria: Thanks all. Ill do a quick pass on copy in Drive in 30m. If anyone sees something urgent, drop here. :calendar:
